import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings

warnings.simplefilter("ignore")

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Separate features and target
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["Id", "Cover_Type"]]
X = train_df[feature_cols].values
y = train_df["Cover_Type"].values - 1  # Convert to 0-indexed for LightGBM
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].values

# Use non-stratified split with 90/10 ratio to increase training data while maintaining hold-out validation
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.1, random_state=42)

# Create datasets
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

# Base LightGBM parameters
base_params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "num_class": 7,
    "metric": "multi_error",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "num_leaves": 63,
    "min_child_samples": 20,
    "verbose": -1,
}

# Number of ensemble models
n_models = 10
val_preds = []
test_preds = []

# Train ensemble of models with different seeds and slightly varied hyperparameters
for i in range(n_models):
    params = base_params.copy()
    params["seed"] = i

    # Introduce controlled diversity in feature/bagging fractions
    params["feature_fraction"] = 0.75 + 0.05 * (
        i % 4
    )  # cycles through 0.75, 0.80, 0.85, 0.90
    params["bagging_fraction"] = 0.75 + 0.05 * ((i + 1) % 4)
    params["bagging_freq"] = 5

    # Train model with early stopping
    model = lgb.train(
        params,
        train_data,
        valid_sets=[train_data, val_data],
        valid_names=["train", "valid"],
        num_boost_round=500,
        callbacks=[
            lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False),
            lgb.log_evaluation(period=0),
        ],
    )

    # Validate
    val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
    val_preds.append(val_pred)

    # Predict on test set
    test_pred = model.predict(X_test)
    test_preds.append(test_pred)

# Average ensemble predictions
val_pred_avg = np.mean(val_preds, axis=0)
val_pred_classes = np.argmax(val_pred_avg, axis=1)
accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, val_pred_classes)
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {accuracy:.6f}")

# Average test predictions and convert to 1-indexed
test_pred_avg = np.mean(test_preds, axis=0)
test_pred_classes = np.argmax(test_pred_avg, axis=1) + 1

# Create submission
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_df["Id"], "Cover_Type": test_pred_classes})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
